notes.title: Big Update!
notes.content:
Hi guys.

notes.title: Results of GIVEAWAY
notes.content:
[b]Hello guys![/b]

[previewyoutube=LfzimZULj2s;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] SaintFromThirdStreet
[*] Plague_gamehag.com

[*] Dominator

Thank you all very much for participating, stay tuned for our news and wait for new events. Thanks to all!)

[i]Thanks and good luck!
Yoba Games Team[/i]
